# Nested_Learning_Paradigm

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A paradigm that unifies deep learning architectures as nested optimization equation systems for associative memory, rather than as layered feedforward functions. Provides a theoretical foundation for designing in-network neuromorphic systems that can perform continuous learning and memory consolidation directly on network substrates.
